campaign: tmux catch-up: refusals revisit, pin to 3.8, floating panes

milestones.M2: pin.* items merged (pin at the 3.8 tag, drift adopted or registered)

items.title: Raw TUI honours terminal-overrides, terminal-features and user-keys
accept: With TERM=xterm-256color, no COLORTERM, and `set -as terminal-overrides ',*:Tc'`, the raw TUI emits 24-bit SGR (today it downgrades to 256 at render.rs:3599 while #{client_colours} says 16777216).
terminal-features RGB and extkeys reach the raw TUI from the mask the daemon already computes (daemon.rs:40085-40105); the TUI raises colour depth and arms extended keys from it.
user-keys entries produce User0..User9 keys in the raw TUI and fire `bind UserN` bindings.
options.client-terminal-negotiation keeps only extended-keys-format, assume-paste-time and xterm-keys, with the false 'zz never reads terminfo' claim removed.

items.title: Close the last two caller-stream refusals
accept: show-buffer on a buffer with non-UTF-8 bytes writes raw bytes to a command client and escapes them for attached and control clients, as the pin does (cmd-save-buffer.c:98-108, server-client.c:3024-3026); vis_escape at status.rs:3120 does the escaping.
`printf 'set -g @x a\376b\n' | zz source-file -` applies like the pin instead of failing with 'stream did not contain valid UTF-8'.
protocol.binary-streams closes.

items.title: capture-pane -H and the derivable -F line flags
accept: capture-pane -H prints each unique hyperlink URI per line, deduped across the capture, skipping lines without links (cmd-capture-pane.c:201-237).
capture-pane -F emits the W, H, P and O line flags; D and X are recorded as native in the registry.
capture.rich-transports keeps only -P, -R and the saved alternate grid.

items.title: choose-tree/choose-client/choose-buffer -N and -NN
accept: -N opens the chooser with the preview off and -NN with the big preview, as mode-tree.c:578-584; today -NN is refused (command.rs:17025-17030) and -N is ignored (daemon.rs:35784, 36635).
The stale 'choosers have no preview pane' text in divergences.md:710-713 is removed.

items.title: Raw TUI reads tree-mode styles and prompt cursor style and colour
accept: tree-mode-border-style, tree-mode-selection-style and tree-mode-preview-style replace the hard-coded styles at daemon/chooser_presentation.rs:184, 529, 669.
prompt-cursor-style, prompt-cursor-colour, prompt-command-cursor-style and prompt-command-cursor-colour are honoured by the raw TUI prompt.
Both registry groups shrink to what stays native (GUI presentation, copy-mode line numbers, fill-character, message-format if not done).

items.title: pane_current_command fallback, refresh-client -l, new-session -t hint, registry hygiene
accept: pane_current_command with no foreground process answers the start command, then the default shell, as format.c:933-953 (today '' at daemon.rs:487-491); formats.pane-current-command-empty closes.
refresh-client -l in the raw TUI queries the outer terminal's clipboard with OSC 52 and stores the reply as a buffer (cmd-refresh-client.c:244-247).
The catalog descriptions of refresh-client -c -D -L -R -U (catalog.rs:1594-1600) are corrected.
new-session -t answers its refusal with a hint to use attach -t <session>.
mouse.bound-context's reason points at the scrollbar and floating-pane items that actually block it.
The raw TUI's top-left crop of an oversized pane and attach -r self-promotion via switch-client -r are recorded in divergences.md.

items.title: Move the pin to the tmux 3.8 tag and register the whole delta
accept: The pin is tag 3.8 (7f2a35ad3321f9ba57a1062ca73b1f3ff26aca53); fetch-tmux.sh, its build stamp and third_party/tmux-reference/UPSTREAM.md name it.

tmux-oracle.py handles 3.8: 8 args_parse callbacks, the event-payload hook_* family (events-payload.c), propagation in hooks.c:hooks_parse, 37 modifiers. It also records option scope and default so scope and default changes show up in a diff.

Every delta item in the research doc Part 2 is either already matched or registered in tmux-gaps.json under an open gap owned by a pin.* or float.* item, so `just compat check` is green at the new pin.
No zz behaviour changes in this item except what the gate forces (catalog flag shapes for new flags may be registered as unsupported until their item lands).
notes: Measured delta and a soft-assert oracle runner: ~/.cache/zz-catchup/ on alienware (delta.md, tools/, oracle-38.json); rebuild from the research doc elsewhere.

items.title: 3.8 contract breaks: active-pane flag, %% quoting, q: escaping, relative targets
accept: The active-pane client flag is gone as in 1ce00006 (zz-client core.rs:1677, zz-cli lib.rs:3597).
%% escapes ' as '\'' (a177d0f5, cmd.c:843-916); %%%, %N% and %N unchanged.
q: escapes {, }, newline and tab (d57d75de).
Invalid relative targets such as +foo and -0 are errors (00f3899a).

items.title: JSON v2 layout strings
accept: #{window_layout}, #{window_visible_layout} and list-windows print the 3.8 JSON v2 form (bf43fdc0, d9692f7e).
select-layout accepts both v1 and v2.
Control clients get v1 unless they set the new-layouts flag.
The v2 writer has a place for floating panes so float.core only fills it in.

items.title: display-panes as a pane mode
accept: -b removed; -k, -Z and -s source-window accepted; -t is a target pane (1a02c995).
display-panes-active-colour, -colour, -format and -time are window options; display-panes-border-style exists.
Raw TUI matches the pin's mode screen; desktop keeps its native overlay.

items.title: 3.8 hooks, event payloads, set-hook -E/-T, wait-for -E/-v/-l/-w/-F
accept: The 21 new hooks fire where the pin fires them; after-queue removed. pane-command-started, pane-command-finished and pane-shell-prompt come from OSC 133, which zz's last-output tracking already parses.
hook_<key> payload formats resolve; old names still resolve.
set-hook -E fires a user event; set-hook -T gates a -B monitor; wait-for -E -v -l -w -F behave as 3.8.

items.title: 3.8 formats, modifiers, options and show -F
accept: The 16 new format_table names and the new context formats resolve (or are registered native with a reason).
The A modifier works in status and border formats; q: change lands in pin.contract-breaks.
clear-on-attach, copy-mode-current-line-style, remain-on-exit failed-key exist; fill-character, pane-active-border-style and status-format defaults match 3.8.
show-options, show-window-options and show-hooks accept -F; display-message -j works; capture-pane -I is adopted or registered native (libghostty keeps no per-row time).

items.title: 3.8 default keys, menus and copy-mode commands
accept: Default tables match 3.8 (303 to 308), except bindings whose commands belong to float.* (C-MouseDrag1 new-pane -M), which stay registered under float.keys.
line-numbers-on/off/toggle and refresh-now copy commands work; copy-mode L and r rebind.
Menus belong to the window (ad6832e6) where zz's model allows, or the divergence is recorded.

items.title: Floating panes design: the popup becomes window-owned
accept: knowledge/designs/floating-panes.md specifies: the floating layer on Window (z_order already exists, model.rs:234-262), how display-popup becomes a window-owned floating modal pane (as upstream 34cd5da4), snapshot and wire shape, sizing and clamping on window shrink, zoom, hit-testing order, and what each client draws.

It lists the 3.8 surface it covers (new-pane incl. -O -A -W -K -C -D -M, break-pane -W -x -y -X -Y, move-pane -P -X -Y -z and directions, join-pane tiling a floating pane, swap-pane, resize-pane on floating panes, split-window inside a floating pane, pane_floating_flag, pane_modal_flag, window_modal_pane, choose-tree z sort, top-floating/bottom-floating borders, the move table, prefix * @ g, editor).
It names the implementation split into float.core, float.clients and float.keys with file zones.
Codex has reviewed it and fabrico has not objected in the ledger notes.
notes: Design only, no compile: can run beside two compiling lanes.
